description: Ask Codex to generate (or edit) raster images with its image generation tool. Images are saved into `output_dir` as they are made, and their paths returned. Pass reference_images to edit or riff on existing images, and session_id to iterate on a previous result. Set `count` for batches so progress and resumes are tracked. Runs on gpt-6-luna at high effort by default; leave model/effort unset unless the user asks. Calls take ~1 min per image; use background=true for batches.

background.description: Optional. true = return a job_id immediately and keep working; collect the result later with codex_result. Default false (wait for the answer).

count.description: Optional number of images wanted. Enables progress (k/count) and precise resumes.

effort.description: Optional. Default high; rarely needs changing.

model.description: Optional. Default gpt-6-luna; rarely needs changing.

output_dir.description: Absolute directory where the images should be saved (created if missing).

prompt.description: Description of the image(s): subject, style, size/aspect ratio, background (e.g. transparent), variations.

reference_images.description: Optional absolute paths of images to attach as references or to edit.

session_id.description: Optional. Continue an earlier Codex thread (e.g. "make it darker").

name: codex_image
